title: Subset-intersection weight sum
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\\delta$ be real, and let $S,U$ be subsets of $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$. The sum over all subsets $J$ of $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$ of the weight $\\delta^{|J|}(1-\\delta)^{n-|J|}$ when $U\\cap J=S$ (and zero otherwise) equals $\\delta^{|S|}(1-\\delta)^{|U\\setminus S|}$ if $S\\subseteq U$, and equals zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Subsets $S$ and $U$ of the coordinate set
